description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, link principal): a Link opens one share's tunnel with POST /api/v1/shares/:id/tunnel and a website.share-connect-request@1. The edge checks the Network Link token (client credentials, subject link:lnk_…, audience openvibe.website) and the short-lived, single-use tunnel token minted by Connect; neither alone opens the route. The Link token's subject must equal link:<node_id> from the request, and a mismatch is refused and audited. Not delegated to user or app tokens.
